timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,336.41 Cr (+17.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹325.81 Cr (+22.4% YoY).
Uno Minda reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹5,336 Cr (+18% YoY) and FY26 normalised revenue of ₹19,589 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹1.75 per share.
Uno Minda announced board approval for a ₹550 Cr greenfield plant for 4W EV powertrains in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra.
Uno Minda reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹5,336 Cr and guided for stable EBITDA margins in FY27.

Uno Minda Limited, via Tarun Kumar Srivastava (ICSI M. No. A11994), published notices in *Financial Express* and *Jansatta* on 02 June 2026 urging shareholders to claim unclaimed dividends from FY 2018-19 to prevent transfer to IEPF.
Uno Minda Limited’s Tarun Kumar Srivastava (ICSI Mem. No. A11994) shared the earnings call audio link on August 04, 2026, for Q1 FY2027 results.
